main_text.head: PROPHETIA SINGVLARIS ET Ecclesiæ propria.
main_text.l: Transitionem præparatoriam, quis, cui reuelauerit: cap. 10.
Rem ipsâ, de statu Ecclesiæ qualis est
In hoc mundo: vbi de scriptio Ecclesiæ
prius de Ecclesiæ ortu cap. 12. progressu cap. 13.
Post huius mundi finem, de Ecclesia triumphante, cap. 21. & 22.
main_text.p: Cap. x. Duo sunt parasceuastica seu præparatoria in Transitione: vnum, Christi reuelantis mysteria sua & seruum suum vocantis authoritas: vsque ad v. 8. alterum, singularis ad hunc locum repetita, queque Iohannis vocatio ad perceptionem sequentis prophetiæ: quæ mandatur ipsi primum signo, v. 8. 9. 10. Deinde apertis verbis, versu vltimo.

p.i: Expositâ authoritate reuelationis institutæ, & necessitate vocationis illius quæ Iohanni singulariter fuit imperata, deinceps historia subiicitur de statu Ecclesiæ Christi, tum certantis siue militantis, tum vincentis in Christo: Nam & Ecclesia Christi certare edicitur contra Pseudochristianam Ecclesiam cui Antichristus imperat, Christo Iesu confundente Antichristum spiritu oris sui: & Christus vincere gloriosissimè, donec interueniet Antichristum reuelatione aduentus sui, vt, quemadmodum[?] docet Apostolus 2. Thessal. 2.

page.notes: The "Certantis" label is set beside a brace in the diagram; I placed it as its own line and assigned the diagram levels by eye, so the nesting is approximate. The opening of the paragraph and the foot note are set in italic; the boundary between roman and italic is uncertain in places. "quemadmodum" is hard to read in the scan and is marked [?]. The vertical label at the left is a bracket label, not a note.
